title: Senior Lecturer of Business Administration
bio: Overview Kevin Mohan is currently researching negotiations in private company contexts, including topics such as financings, compensation systems, budgeting and planning, recruiting, and succession. Keywords: Compensation ; Succession ; Family Business ; Negotiation ; Negotiation Process ; Private Ownership ; Finance ; Compensation and Benefits ; Budgets and Budgeting ; Recruitment ; Management Succession

Mohan Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Kevin Mohan joined the Negotiation, Organizations & Markets unit at Harvard Business School in 2012 after a long career as a private equity investor. He teaches Negotiation in the MBA program and the Owners, Presidents, and Managers program. He also teaches War & Peace and The Entrepreneurial Manager in the MBA curriculum.
